name: Towns under the Towns Improvement Act 3 May 1921
description: The four towns in Northern Ireland governed by town commissioners under the Towns Improvement (Ireland) Act 1854 when Northern Ireland was founded: Antrim, Aughnacloy, Downpatrick and Gilford, until 31 Mar 1925. Town commissioners under the 1854 Act levied a limited rate and carried out minor works; for public health each town stayed under its rural district council (1937 Census General Report). Each town is drawn from the DED that matches its legal boundary: Antrim Urban, Aughnacloy Urban, Downpatrick Urban and Whitehead Urban, and Gilford as reconstituted in 1923 (Gilford Town is exactly the Gilford DED in the 1926 and 1951 censuses); Kilkeel is the townlands of Kilkeel and Magheramurphy, which the 1934 boundary order names. The drawn areas agree with the printed town areas within 2.4% (Aughnacloy +0.2%, Whitehead +0.8%, Gilford -2.1%, Antrim -2.3%). No order altering any town's limits has been found in the Belfast Gazette, 1922-1962.

references.note: p. xviii, change (t): Downpatrick, formerly a town under the 1854 Act in Downpatrick Rural District, created an urban district (1 Apr 1925).

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1937: General Report
references.note: p. vii (four towns possess this form of government) and changes (a) Whitehead urban district, 1 Apr 1927, and (j) Kilkeel made a town under the 1854 Act, 1 Aug 1934.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 196 (Town of Whitehead)
references.note: 27 Mar 1925. Ministry order of 24 Mar 1925 approving the adoption of the 1854 Act within the boundaries of the order of 3 Feb 1925 (printed in issue 189, 6 Feb 1925), in force 1 Apr 1925; nine commissioners.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 677 (Town of Kilkeel)
references.note: 15 Jun 1934. Ministry order of 13 Jun 1934 approving the adoption of the 1854 Act within the boundaries of the order of 16 Apr 1934 (townlands of Kilkeel and Magheramurphy; printed in issue 670, 27 Apr 1934), in force 1 Aug 1934; nine commissioners.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 809 (Kilkeel Rural District)
references.note: 25 Dec 1936. Recites that the town of Kilkeel comprised Kilkeel North and Kilkeel South DEDs and part of Kilkeel East DED, and the order of 21 Jul 1936 making it an urban district from 1 Apr 1937.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 155 (Town of Downpatrick)
references.note: 13 Jun 1924. Ministry order separating the town of Downpatrick (a town having commissioners under the 1854 Act) from Downpatrick Rural District as an urban sanitary district from 1 Apr 1925.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1979 (Aughnacloy; Gilford)
references.note: 29 May 1959. Notices of the Local Government (Dissolution of Commissioners) (Aughnacloy) and (Gilford) Orders (NI) 1959, S.R. & O. 1959 Nos. 50 and 51, dissolving the commissioners and transferring their functions.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 2128 (Antrim)
references.note: 6 Apr 1962. Notice of the Local Government (Dissolution of Commissioners) (Antrim) Order (NI) 1962, S.R. & O. 1962 No. 50, transferring the commissioners' functions to Antrim Rural District Council; the 1961 and 1966 censuses date this 1 Apr 1962.
